mods.name: Nimbus Nova MC
mods.description: A cooperative Mars mission prototype with a shared power budget, oxygen, crew roles, outpost, equipment and mission HUD.

releases.notes:
Nimbus Nova is a cooperative Minecraft astronaut mission trainer for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. Crews share limited power and supplies, work at stations across six missions, and review the consequences of their decisions in a debrief.

## New in 0.2.0

- **Redesigned interface.** New terminal theme for every screen, a compact mission HUD, and a mission hub that shows what each mission teaches.
- **Reworked station tasks.** Power routing, the oxygen recycler, docking, navigation, signal tuning, descent and the other ship stations have new visuals, sounds, keyboard and scroll controls, and a space fact that explains why the task matters.
- **Minimap.** Shows the floor plan, your crew and the next waypoint. Press **M** to toggle it.
- **Rebuilt sites.** The Moon surface and the shelter, long-night and greenhouse sites have new terrain, craters, landers and buildings.
- **New props and effects.** Solar panels, satellite dishes, beacon masts and supply crates, plus ambient particles and a low-air suit warning.
- **Trailer and pitch deck** are attached below.

Worlds created with 0.1.0 keep their existing sites, so the new prop blocks only appear in new worlds.

| File | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `NimbusNova.mrpack` | Import in a Modrinth-compatible launcher. Includes the mod, matching Fabric API, and the crew and teacher guides. |
| `nimbus-nova-mc-0.2.0.jar` | Manual Fabric installation on the Minecraft client and dedicated server. Install Fabric API `0.165.2+26.3` alongside it. |
| `NimbusNova-Trailer.mp4` | 29-second trailer made from in-game footage. |
| `NOVA-Pitch-v2.pptx` | Seven-slide pitch deck. |

Use **Minecraft Java Edition 26.3**, **Java 25**, and **Fabric Loader 0.20.1**. For a solo demonstration, enter a world with commands enabled and open **`/nimbus`**. Select a mission, choose a crew role, and follow the amber waypoint. For a classroom session, use the teacher panel from the source repository.

The release runs on the team’s authored maps. The Darkening Sky uses published Opportunity observations to set the effect of dust on solar generation. See the source register for the measured inputs, game assumptions, licenses, and AI assistance.

[Project and gameplay gallery](https://github.com/KawaseDev/Nimbus-Nova-MC) · [Teacher guide](https://github.com/KawaseDev/Nimbus-Nova-MC/blob/v0.2.0/TEACHER_GUIDE.md) · [Sources and credits](https://github.com/KawaseDev/Nimbus-Nova-MC/blob/v0.2.0/CREDITS.md)

readmeSummary: Dust cuts power at a Mars outpost. The crew can keep oxygen running or use that energy to finish a science task, and every specialist sees different readings.
